title: Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay
summary: Anthropic wants to have it both ways. With its impending IPO, it wants to tap the vast riches of the public markets and insists it doesn't want to compromise its core mission of developing AI safely and for the benefit of humanity. But greater model capabilities bring greater risks, and shareholders eager for returns may […]
llm_summary: Anthropic is gearing up for an IPO, hoping to tap public‑market capital while still championing its mission of building safe, human‑beneficial AI. The company argues that a broader shareholder base won’t force it to compromise safety, even as its models become more powerful and the associated risks rise. Critics, however, warn that investors focused on returns could pressure Anthropic to prioritize speed and profit over rigorous safety safeguards.
